## Judgment

### Expected-drift set

Empty. This is a pure structural refactor: `lib/themes/default.nix` introduces
a named theme registry containing exactly one entry, `ayu-dark`, carrying
today's exact stylix values (ayu-dark.yaml scheme, base0D=39BAE6 override,
polarity dark) plus the ayu-light noctalia table moved verbatim from
`noctalia-stylix-home.nix`. `modules/desktop/theme.nix` is rewritten to
declare `nix-nexus.theme.{name,accent,wallpapers.enable}` (default
`"ayu-dark"`) and derive `stylix.{base16Scheme,polarity,override}` from the
registry lookup instead of hardcoding them. `noctalia-stylix-home.nix` now
reads its light palette from the active theme via `osConfig` (with a dark
fallback) instead of a hardcoded table. No flake input moved
(`lock-diff.sh 40b271a HEAD` shows zero `flake.lock` node changes), and no
host or HM config selects a non-default theme — every config keeps consuming
the same default (`ayu-dark`) it always evaluated to. Since the registry
default reproduces the prior hardcoded values byte-for-byte and the light
table was moved, not edited, every evaluated config (sweet16, petunia, avina,
hermes, groot@dualie, groot@forge — groot@rk3588 is N/A on x86_64) is expected
to be unaffected.
